correctness.rationale: The exact 336-element group and 457 nonempty independent faces give a rank-preserving barycentric quotient CW complex with cell counts (14,64,149,218,210,120,30). All chain boundary compositions vanish. Exact integer Smith normal forms in dimensions 1–6 have ranks (13,51,98,120,90,30), with every nonzero diagonal invariant equal to 1, proving integral acyclicity. A 13-edge tree gives 51 fundamental-group generators; every one is eliminated by a length-one consequence of 149 attaching relators, proving simple connectivity. Hurewicz and Whitehead then prove contractibility. All enumerations and elimination rules are independently reproducible by verify.py.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the canonical Fano-plane incidence graph with a natural full 336-element automorphism group. Its independence complex has nontrivial six-dimensional third homology, making the full symmetry quotient an intrinsic and motivated invariant. The new exact classification proves actual contractibility, excluding possible integral torsion and nonabelian pi1 obstructions not excluded by the prior rational character. It is a complete natural low-order finite-geometry case rather than a routine reparameterization or arbitrary slice.
